result.summary: The page is visually clean and well-structured, with only a minor cosmetic suggestion regarding horizontal scroll boundaries.

issues.description: Text and cards on the far right of horizontal scroll sections, such as 'Trattoria Piccolo', clip abruptly at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Implement a subtle gradient fade-out on the right edge of horizontal scroll containers to visually indicate more content is available without abrupt clipping.
